item.title: Equipment to fix sewage plant not yet ordered: company
item.description: Wellington Water's Moa Point treatment plant (file photo). Photo: Wellington Water By Bill Hickman of RNZ Wellington Water says replacement equipment to repair the failed Moa Point wastewater plant is yet to be ordered.

item.title: Wimbledon ideal return for Serena, says Djokovic
item.description: Serena Williams has not played since the 2022 US Open. Photo: Getty Images Novak Djokovic has suggested that Serena Williams could see Wimbledon as the ideal venue to return to tennis if the 23-times Grand Slam champion decides to make a comeback later this year.

item.title: Minister quizzed about exchange with TVNZ chair
item.description: Broadcasting Minister Paul Goldsmith. Photo: RNZ Broadcasting Minister Paul Goldsmith says he "may have grunted" at TVNZ's board chair Andrew Barclay, who raised a crime story with him.

item.title: Cromwell College student second in national poetry competition
item.description: Katie Anne Ley Year 9 Cromwell College Student Katie Anne Ley has come second place in the Junior Section of a National Poetry Competiton with her poem, 'A Love Letter to Colours'.

item.title: Urgent recall after beer mislabelled as alcohol free
item.description: More than 2500 cases have been recalled. Photo: MPI/supplied Alcohol Healthwatch's executive director says he is "horrified" after tens of thousands of Steinlager beer bottles were mislabelled as alcohol free.

item.title: Halliday leads the way as NZ thump Zimbabwe
item.description: Brooke Halliday on her way to bringing up her century against Zimbabwe at the University Oval. Looking on is wicketkeeper Modester Mupachikwa. PHOTO: GERARD O'BRIEN Zimbabwe will be wondering why they chose to field first.

item.title: Nothing to suggest Gloriavale children unsafe: Minister
item.description: The Gloriavale compound on the West Coast. Photo: RNZ By Jean Edwards of RNZ Senior government minister Louise Upston says she did not see anything on a visit to Gloriavale that caused concern about children's safety at the West Coast Christian community.
